text:
Sofia: Hey team, I addressed the comments on PR #432 (metrics leak). Squashed the fixups and updated the changelog. PTAL when you have a minute.
Dan: Thanks — I'll do a quick pass now.
Liam: Quick Q: did you keep the old counter for fallback? want to make sure we don't regress the alerting.
Sofia: Good call. I left a shim so alerts still see the old metric name, then we emit the new one too. Small patch below:```diff
- metrics.increment('kv_cache_hits')
+ metrics.increment('kv.cache.hits')
+ metrics.increment('kv_cache_hits')  # shim for alerts
```
Dan: Nice. Do you have a unit test that verifies both names are emitted?
Sofia: Yep added a test in metrics_test.py — pushed as commit 0f9a7b2. CI queued.
CI Bot: Build queued for commit 0f9a7b2 — running unit tests.
CI Bot: Build passed — 18 tests, 2 slow tests skipped, coverage 89.2% :white_check_mark: 
Liam: left one tiny nit about an assertion message, otherwise LGTM.
Dan: I agree with Liam, +1 after that nit.
Sofia: Nit addressed (changed assertion message). Rebased onto main and force-pushed.
ReleaseOpsBot: Heads-up: merging is gated — we need 2 code approvals and the canary window open. No auto-merge until checks and approvals satisfied.
Sofia: Thanks. I'm aiming for the 09:00 PT canary tomorrow. Can someone give the second approval?
Liam: I can approve now.
Dan: Approving now too — go ahead and schedule the merge.
Sofia: Thanks both! I'll book the merge slot for 09:00 PT tomorrow and post in #eng-oncall with rollback notes. 
Sofia: PTAL resolved — merging tomorrow after canary if no regression. :rocket:
